out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor, in the walk-in freezer.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. CORRECTED DURING THE INSPECTION. SUNRISE AT HUNTER MILL (Inspection Date: 07/09/2026) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. CORRECTED DURING THE INSPECTION

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: Knife stored in-between two refrigeratorson the cook-line.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. Place the knife on a knife rack, or inside a cleaned and sanitized container or tray, to protect the knife from contamination.. CORRECTED DURING THE INSPECTION

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed that the The interior walls of the walk-in refrigerator are soiled and in need of cleaning.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. Clean the walls inside the unit to prevent dirt build-up

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed that the @Physical structure@ is not maintained in good repair.The floor inside the walk-in refrigerator is damaged with rust and needs to be repaired or be replaced.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. Observed food boxes stored on the floor in the walk-in freezer.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage.CORRECTED DURING THE INSPECTION.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The exterior nonfood-contact surfaces of the white food tubs located at the back work area, are in need of cleaning.
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. Clean these tubs more frequently.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed that the floor in the walk-in refrigerator is not maintained in good repair. The floor in this unit is very rusty and damaged.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. Replace the flooring inside the walk-in freezer.

violations.title: Mechanical Warewashing, Hot Water Sanitization, 180F
violations.observation: The water temperature in the manifold servicing the high temperature warewashing machine was below the minimum allowable level of 180F. Temperature observed was noted to be 155F.
violations.corrective_action: In a mechanical operation the temperature of the fresh hot water sanitizing rinse as it enters the manifold may not be more than 194F or less than 165F for a stationary rack, single temperature machine or for all other machines, 180F. Use the 3-vat sink top Wash Rinse and Sanitize utensils and equipment, and do not operate the dish machine until after it has been fixed

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: baked ground beef patties, @ steam table=129F Sausages-72F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. Groundbeef patties=(Reheated ); sausages = (discarded).

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: Chicken salad=44F. @ walk-in Refrigerator.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. Discarded.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: chicken salad, diced cooked chicken.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. Chef placed the prep dates on both items , based on items prep at the same time.

violations.title: Hot Water Sanitizing Temperature Met
violations.observation: Due to improper operation of the hot water, mechanical warewashing machine, the THERMAL PLATE TEMPERATURE READING WAS BELOW 160F indicating that food-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils are not being adequately sanitized.
violations.corrective_action: Immediately discontinue use of the dishmachine. Repair the dishmachine so that a thermolabel will turn black. Until the machine is adequately repaired, set up the 3 vat sink to manually wash, rinse and chemically sanitize food-contact surfaces.

violations.title: Mechanical Warewashing, Hot Water Sanitization, 180F
violations.observation: The water temperature in the manifold servicing the high temperature warewashing machine was below the minimum allowable level of 180F.
violations.corrective_action: In a mechanical operation the temperature of the fresh hot water sanitizing rinse as it enters the manifold may not be more than 194F or less than 165F for a stationary rack, single temperature machine or for all other machines, 180F.

violations.title: Mechanical Warewashing, Sanitization Pressure
violations.observation: The pressure gauge for the high temperature warewashing machine was below 5 PSI or above 30 PSI. The pressure gauge is not working.
violations.corrective_action: The flow pressure of the fresh hot water sanitizing rinse in a warewashing machine shall be within the range specified on the machine manufacturer's data plate and may not be less than 5 PSI or more than 30 PSI as measured in the water line immediately downstream or upstream from the fresh hot water sanitizing rinse control valve. Repair the pressure gauge or replace it if it cannot be repaired.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: sausage at 106F in steam well in 3rd floor kitchen. Sausage was being stored on wire pan grate within container in steam well.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. EHS showed employee how to properly reheat for hot holding using the microwave - sausages were reheated in microwave to 185F and placed back into steam well. Sausage should be stored directly in container, so that food surface has maximum contact with bottom of container in steam well.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: individual cream cheese container at 61F on counter at drink station.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CFM discarded individual cream cheese containers that were on counter. Cream cheese should be kept in refrigeration unit and stored at 41F or below.

violations.title: Proper Thawing Methods for ROP Fish
violations.observation: Observed salmon in intact ROP packaging thawing in WIC.
violations.corrective_action: CFM removed salmon from ROP packaging to continue thawing.

violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. CFM to clean walls. Provide proof of cleaning to EHS.

out_items.name: Adequate ventilation and lighting, designated areas used

violations.title: Ventilation Hood, Adequate
violations.observation: Observed what appeared to be a sheet of metal blocking the type II hood vent hole above the heat sanitizing dish machine.
violations.corrective_action: Ventilation hood systems and devices shall operate properly and be sufficient in number and capacity to prevent grease or condensation from collecting on walls and ceilings. CFM must contact maintenance or other repair to ensure that condensate is able to be pulled into hood. Please send proof of repair/removal of blockage to EHS.

violations.title: Chemical Sanitization, Quaternary Ammonium Requirements
violations.observation: When tested, the quaternary ammonium compound-based sanitizing solution was observed to be at a concentration less than what is required for effective sanitization of food-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils. Observed the sanitizing solution AT THE PREP TABLE with a concentration of 0 ppm total quaternary ammonium compound.
violations.corrective_action: The quaternary ammonium sanitizer used in this facility shall have a minimum concentration of at least 200 ppm OR a concentration between 150-400ppm based on the manufacturer's use directions and using the appropriate test kit. EHS FOUND AIR BUBBLE IN QUATERNARY AMMONIUM LINE. LINE WAS PRIMED AND QUATERNARY AMMONIA WAS MEASURED AT 200-400PPM. CFM REPLACED SANITIZER IN ORIGINALLY TESTED CONTAINER.

violations.title: Hot Water Sanitizing Temperature Met
violations.observation: OBSERVED A PLATE SURFACE TEMPERATURE OF 156F AT MAIN KITCHEN HEAT SANITIZING DISH MACHINE.
violations.corrective_action: Immediately discontinue use of the dishmachine. Repair the dishmachine so that a thermolabel will turn black. Until the machine is adequately repaired, set up the 3 vat sink to manually wash, rinse and chemically sanitize food-contact surfaces. CFM IN POSSESSION OF REPLACEMENT PART. CFM COORDINATING REPAIR WITH VENDOR. CFM IS SANITIZING ALL CLEANED DISHWARE FROM DISH MACHINE IN 3 COMPARTMENT SINK SANITIZER BASIN. CFM TO PROVIDE PROOF OF REPAIR TO EHS. SUNRISE AT HUNTER MILL (Inspection Date: 11/26/2024) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Adequate ventilation and lighting, designated areas used

violations.title: Ventilation Hood, Designed to Prevent Condensate Drip
violations.observation: OBSERVED THE VENTILATION HOOD’S, ABOVE HEAT SANITIZING DISH MACHINE, OPENING WAS CLOSED. SYSTEM IS NOT ABLE TO EFFECTIVELY REMOVE CONDENSATION PRODUCED FROM EQUIPMENT.
violations.corrective_action: Exhaust ventilation hood systems in food preparation and warewashing areas including components such as hoods, fans, guards, and ducting shall be designed to prevent grease or condensation from draining or dripping onto food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items. CFM WILL CHECK WITH MAINTENANCE AS TO WHY HOOD OPENING CLOSED. CFM WILL REMOVE COVERING AS SOON AS POSSIBLE. CFM TO PROVIDE PROOF TO EHS.
